subject_line: Why Your Feed Is Full of Beef Right Now
opening: Happy Sunday, friend. This week the carnivore community did something kind of wild, and your social feed is probably still recovering. We've also got a few things inside that'll make your Monday a lot easier, whether you're heading to a restaurant or bracing for the break room donut ambush.

hero.title: Why Everyone's Posting Their Carnivore Before Photos
hero.teaser: Something shifted in the carnivore community this week, and it's showing up all over social media in a big way. Before photos are flooding feeds, and not just from the people you'd expect. Some of what's being shared is genuinely striking, but some of it is getting a lot more complicated than a simple glow-up story. Chloe breaks down what's real, what's not, and why this moment actually matters for all of us.

supporting.title: The Carnivore Endurance Problem Nobody Talks About
supporting.teaser: Marcus found the wall most carnivore athletes hit during long cardio, and knowing it exists is only half the battle.

supporting.title: The Carnivore Restaurant Order That Never Fails
supporting.teaser: There's one order the community swears by at almost any restaurant, and it's probably not what you'd guess.

supporting.title: Fasted Training on Carnivore: Does It Actually Work
supporting.teaser: Marcus tested the TikTok claim that you can crush any workout on zero food, and the answer depends on one thing most people overlook.

try_this_week: Pick one meal out this week and go full carnivore, no exceptions. Before you leave the house, check Chloe's restaurant order guide so you know exactly what to say when the server arrives. Community members report that having a default order ready is the single biggest thing that keeps them on track when eating out.
looking_ahead: Next week we're getting into something Sarah's been researching for months, and it might change how you think about what carnivore is actually doing to your blood work.
